source: CLAUDE.md §Critical warnings (Inceptor) — adopted by JustSplit in Track A (ADR 0001)
purpose: Single source of banned module specifiers. centinela's forbidden-import scan reads THIS file — change a rule here, not in prose. Each `pattern` matches an import specifier (prefix match for scopes ending in '/'). Rules under `suspended` are NOT enforced yet: they return to `banned` in the issue named by `restoreIn`.

banned.reason: Base UI is the chosen primitive layer; never mix Radix with Base UI.

The consolidated, unscoped `radix-ui` package (successor to the individual `@radix-ui/*` packages) is still Radix — Base UI is the chosen primitive layer and this bare specifier isn't caught by the `@radix-ui/` scope-prefix pattern above.
Use Tremor Raw (copy-paste) so it tree-shakes and we own the source.
Does not exist for Tailwind v4 — it goes through the Vite plugin.

ADR 0009 permits `@zag-js/<component>` machines for primitives Base UI doesn't ship, but not the full Ark UI wrapper — it carries its own data-scope/data-part styling conventions that would sit awkwardly next to Base UI's render-prop convention.
